decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE
Drawing number AYG/96/2002/2003/Sparrow/04, hereby approved, shows a roof treatment in side elevation for the proposed rear extension that is not consistent with other representations of the proposed extension. It has been assumed that the roof is to have a gable, rather than hip, treatment i.e. as shown in the proposed roof plan and the proposed rear elevation.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to house.
